title: TUR problem report preview
description: What tur-diag report prepare --json prints: exactly what would be sent. P@x's diag_report_prepare tool returns it (with --preview, so prepared_file is null, and with handoff, the person's command). The Rust type tur_diag::report::Preview is authoritative and a test compares the two.

receiver.description: The configured receiver, or null when none is configured and nothing can be sent.

prepared_file.description: Where the prepared bundle was saved; null for a preview, which saves nothing.

report.description: report.json exactly as it stands in the bundle, after redaction.

files.description: Every file in the bundle, in archive order.

missing.description: What could not be collected; the reasons are those of diag-bundle-manifest.schema.json.

identifiers_replaced.description: Replacements per redaction category, as in redaction-report.json.

handoff.description: For a report P@x previewed (prepared_by pax, nothing saved): how the person reads it in full and sends it. P@x never sends a report; the person runs the command, which shows everything again and sends only after the person types yes (docs/architecture/problem-reports.md, section 2.3). null otherwise.

argv.description: The command, one argument per item: tur-diag report submit with the report's redacted fields.

command.description: The same command, quoted for a POSIX shell.
